info.title: eLearning Platform API
info.description: REST API for the eLearning Platform. Authentication uses Bearer JWT tokens. Admin routes require a user with role `admin`.

content.description: Lab content (questions for form, flags for ctf, docker_image for interactive)

answer.description: For CTF (single flag): `{"flag": "FLAG{...}"}`. For CTF (multi-flag): `{"flags": {"flag_id": "FLAG{...}"}}`. For form: `{"answers": {"question_id": "answer"}}`.

get.description: Returns non-sensitive settings used by the frontend (registration flags, password policy).

200.description: User created — returns JWT and user info

400.description: Validation error (username too short, password policy)

403.description: Registration disabled or domain not allowed

400.description: Missing fields or password policy violation

200.description: Authorization URL and CSRF state token

post.summary: Exchange OAuth code for a platform JWT

code.description: Authorization code from the OAuth provider

get.summary: Get a published course by ID

404.description: Course not found or not published

get.summary: Get courses the current user is enrolled in
Get the course leaderboard (must be enrolled)
List labs for a course (must be enrolled)

200.description: List of labs (correct_answers stripped for students)

post.summary: Create a lab (course owner or admin)

400.description: Invalid lab_type or missing flag for CTF

get.summary: Get a single lab with user progress

put.summary: Update a lab (course owner or admin)

delete.summary: Delete a lab (course owner or admin)

post.summary: Submit an answer for a lab

get.summary: Get current user's submission history for a lab
Get current user's progress for a course

400.description: Docker not available or lab not configured for interactive use

200.description: Instance status (`status: none` if no instance)

delete.summary: Stop and remove the running instance

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket that proxies the container's PTY. Auth via `?token=<JWT>`. Send binary frames for stdin. Send `{"type":"resize","rows":N,"cols":N}` as text to resize the PTY.

get.summary: Course monitoring — progress of all enrolled students
Get a lab with flag and correct answers exposed
All student submissions for a lab
Per-lab analytics (success rate, avg score, etc.)

post.summary: Enroll a user in a course

delete.summary: Unenroll a user from a course
